Technology  :  Python,  Tensorflow,  OpenCV,  deep  learning,  Machine  learning  ,image  processing  algorithms,MySql   Description:  Automatic  Number  Plate  Recognition  (ANPR)  is  a  technology  that  uses  advanced  image  processing  and  optical  character  recognition  on  RTSP  (IP)  camera  live  streams/images  to  read  vehicle  registration  plates  in  real  time  to  create  vehicle  location  data.
